# Adhesion Study

I need your help completing a research study on adhesion-controlled rigidity transitions in a multi-cell phase field model, targeting Physical Review E. The study introduces gradient-coupling adhesion and investigates whether it drives a transition analogous to the vertex model shape index transition at p₀* ≈ 3.81.

Before doing anything, please read these files to get up to speed:
1. The agent instructions: `.github/instructions/adhesion-study.instructions.md`
2. The study logbook: `cpp/simulation/study/adhesion/LOG_BOOK.md`
3. The manuscript: `cpp/simulation/study/adhesion/manuscript.tex` (search for `\TODO` markers)

After reading, give me a brief status summary: what phases are complete, what data exists, what the manuscript needs, and what you recommend as the highest-priority next step. Don't start running anything yet.
